description: Buy a launchpad token on its bonding curve with COOK (the launchpad wraps the COOK and opens any missing accounts). ⚠️ You receive program-tracked CURVE SHARES, not SPL tokens: they will not show in get_balance and trade cannot swap them — exit with launchpad_sell, or claim the real token with claim_launchpad after the pool graduates. There is no slippage parameter (the program has no min-out), so the fill can move if others trade first. A 1% trade fee applies. Simulates before sending. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

amountCook.description: how much COOK to spend, e.g. 10

ref.description: the token mint or the launchpad pool address (either works)

referrer.description: optional referrer wallet that earns the referral fee share (not your own)

name: launchpad_buy
title: Buy on a launchpad curve
